guac_hint: Remote desktop in the browser (RDP/VNC/SSH) uses a guacd service. Enter its host and port here.
guac_win: Hold Windows key (toggle) · double-click = press once
guac_clip_take: Take over the clipboard last received from the remote PC
guac_login_save: Save login for this client (including password)
guac_layout: Keyboard layout: characters are sent as layout-independent keysyms
guac_text_ph: Type text, then Send or Enter...
guac_send_enter: Also send Enter after the text
guac_clip_empty: Local clipboard is empty or access was denied (HTTPS required).
guac_copy_manual: Select the text and copy it with Ctrl+C:
guac_clip_send: Send local clipboard to the remote PC
guac_clip_sent: Clipboard sent to the remote session
guac_layout_full: Keyboard layout: characters are sent as layout-independent keysyms – 1:1 is almost always right
